grammarRule.formula: I have an appointment at [Time] with [Person] / Let us reschedule...

explanation.ml: നാളത്തെ പരിപാടികളും കൂടിക്കാഴ്ചകളും ആസൂത്രണം ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ 'I have an appointment at ten AM' (എനിക്ക് പത്തു മണിക്ക് അപ്പോയിന്റ്‌മെന്റ് ഉണ്ട്), 'Could we reschedule our meeting to Wednesday?' (നമ്മുടെ മീറ്റിംഗ് ബുധനാഴ്ചത്തേക്ക് മാറ്റിവെക്കാമോ?) എന്ന് ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു.
explanation.en: Master Tomorrow's Schedule & Appointments with clear formula: I have an appointment at [Time] with [Person] / Let us reschedule...

goldenTip.ml: 💡 ടിപ്പ്: 💡 കൃത്യമായ സമയം പറയുമ്പോൾ 'at': 'at 10:30 AM', ദിവസങ്ങൾക്ക് മുൻപിൽ 'on': 'on Monday', മാസങ്ങൾക്കും വർഷങ്ങൾക്കും മുൻപിൽ 'in': 'in November / in 2026'.
goldenTip.en: Golden Tip: 💡 കൃത്യമായ സമയം പറയുമ്പോൾ 'at': 'at 10:30 AM', ദിവസങ്ങൾക്ക് മുൻപിൽ 'on': 'on Monday', മാസങ്ങൾക്കും വർഷങ്ങൾക്കും മുൻപിൽ 'in': 'in November / in 2026'.

verbs.example: Could we reschedule our client presentation to Thursday afternoon?
verbs.exampleMl: Change the time or date of a planned event.

nouns.definition: An arrangement to meet someone at a particular time and place.
nouns.example: I have a scheduled dental consultation appointment at four PM.

nouns.definition: Change the time or date of a planned event.
nouns.example: Could we reschedule our client presentation to Thursday afternoon?

nouns.definition: The fact or condition of being regarded or treated as more important than others.
nouns.example: Resolving server security is our highest engineering priority.

nouns.definition: A thing that causes someone to remember something.
nouns.example: Set a calendar reminder fifteen minutes before the team sync begins.

nouns.definition: The state of being able to be used, obtained, or free to meet.
nouns.example: Please check the director's availability before booking the flight.

nouns.definition: A list of items of business to be considered and discussed at a meeting.
nouns.example: The chairperson circulated the annual general meeting agenda via email.

traps.question: Select the correct preposition for clock time:
options: I have a meeting at ten AM.
I have a meeting on ten AM.
I have a meeting in ten AM.
I have a meeting by into ten AM.
traps.explanation: Specific clock times take the preposition 'at': 'at ten AM / at 4:30 PM'.
traps.ruleHint: Time Preposition: at + exact clock time.

traps.question: How do you politely suggest moving an appointment to a new date?
options: Cancel my time and make another.
I don't want tomorrow, give day after.
traps.explanation: 'Could we reschedule our appointment?' is professional, respectful, and standard.
traps.ruleHint: Business Politeness: 'Could we reschedule our appointment?'

traps.question: Choose the correct preposition for days of the week: 'We are meeting ______ Wednesday.'
traps.explanation: Days of the week take 'on': 'on Wednesday / on Friday morning'.
traps.ruleHint: Preposition of Time: on + day of the week.
